changelog:
Huawei Cloud SWR image automation skill 1.0.3 focuses on secure and user-confirmed management of image sync and triggers.

- Adds comprehensive documentation for configuring cross-region image sync and auto-deploy triggers, using the hcloud CLI.
- Explicitly lists all operations requiring confirmation, with step-by-step prompts ensuring users approve any create, update, or delete action before execution.
- Details prerequisites, credential setup (AK/SK and temporary token), and security best practices for safe operations.
- Clarifies required IAM permissions for each supported operation, plus error handling and user guidance for permission issues.
- Outlines main use cases, supported commands, and common workflows for SWR automation across multiple Huawei Cloud regions.
summary: Huawei Cloud SWR (Software Repository for Container) image automation and operations skill using hcloud CLI. Use this skill when the user wants to: (1) configure cross-region image sync (auto or manual), (2) manage SWR triggers for auto-deploy to CCE/CCI, (3) query available sync target regions, (4) check sync job status, (5) create/update/delete trigger configurations. Trigger: user mentions "SWR automation", "SWR 自动化", "镜像同步", "SWR sync", "跨区域同步", "cross-region sync", "触发器", "SWR trigger", "自动部署", "auto deploy", "镜像复制", "image replication", "SWR 触发器"
